selection_rule.episodes: Expand both FP01 and FP02, not only the failed row.
sequence: the anchor provider item's unique prev link
the anchor provider item's unique next link
selection_rule.metadata_contract: Fetch only the exact provider item JSON named by each frozen link. Require same collection, exact linked ID, strict zero-pose projection eligibility, and reciprocal prev/next linkage back to the anchor.
selection_rule.pixel_contract: No neighbouring image pixels, thumbnails, tiles, OCR, embeddings, scores, or human image review may be used in selection. Invalid metadata seals the row invalid; do not walk farther or substitute another frame.
selection_rule.aggregation_frozen_for_later_evaluation: For each candidate target, compute the unchanged per-frame facade score for prev/anchor/next and use the arithmetic mean of the highest two of three frame scores. This requires two supporting observations while discarding one worst occluded frame.
selection_rule.no_parameter_search: Sequence length three, top-two mean, unchanged crop, unchanged feature weights, and unchanged score/margin thresholds are one fixed structural hypothesis.
